caption: The drawing depicts a round, lidded vessel shown from two perspectives: a frontal view and a top-down view of the lid. The vessel is mainly white with a smooth, slightly reflective surface, and it features a wide body that narrows towards the base, which is ring-shaped and also white. The lid is domed and fits snugly on top of the vessel, with a small, round knob in the center. Both the body and lid are adorned with a repeating floral and leaf pattern, consisting of large red petals, elongated green leaves, and smaller blue petals or buds, all connected by thin green stems. The decorative elements are primarily arranged around the upper part of the vessel and across the top of the lid, with similar motifs visible in both views. The knob at the top is decorated with radial black-and-white segments. The background is plain and uncolored, and there are no other objects in the composition.
title: Sugar Bowl
